## Context or Background
*What problem were you trying to solve? Why was this important? Include relevant user needs, business goals, or constraints.*

## Research insights

> Example: 80% of participants expected the search function to be in the top-right corner.

## Options Considered

> Example: We considered keeping the existing layout, adding a search bar to the footer, or redesigning the header.

## Decision Made

## Rationale

> Example: This change reduces cognitive load and improves task completion speed.
